import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s = np.sin(0.4*t); c = np.cos(0.4*t); s2 = np.sin(0.8*t); c2 = np.cos(0.8*t)
    h = p[2] + p[3]*t + p[4]*t*t + p[5]*s + p[6]*c + p[7]*s2 + p[8]*c2 + p[9]*np.exp(-t)
    return p[0]*t + p[1]*P*np.log(P) + h/P
